g.text: What the zeros are: environment quenching plus a discrete star-formation floor; mass quenching shows up as low sSFR, not as 0

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Same training split. A: only bins with at least 100 galaxies in that quartile. B: galaxies with log10(1 + overdensity) ≤ 1.365 and SFR > 0; labels give the share below sSFR = 1e-11 /yr. C: the gap between 0 and the smallest positive SFR is empty.
